rules: Definitions and policy only; this file is public. Real readings (Claude percentages from the status line or the owner's /usage, never from token counts) are recorded by `cp.py measure` in the machine-local state dir ($CP_STATE_DIR, default .local/), as is telemetry.

claude_weekly.note: The binding perishable allowance. Shared by all Claude surfaces.

claude_five_hour.note: Pacing constraint only; capacity unused in one window is bounded by the weekly limit.

github_actions.note: Allowance and per-OS minute multipliers per the owner's current GitHub plan; read from GitHub billing. Windows/macOS runners consume the allowance faster than Linux.

owner_attention.note: Derived from telemetry: owner_prompts in session events (Claude, automatic) plus intervention events (weight: 1 prompt/click, 2 short input, 5 setup/auth, 10 manual testing, 20 major workflow).

chatgpt_gpt56.note: Compute is abundant; the scarce part is the owner turn needed to start each package. Counted as owner_prompts reported in PR bodies.

allocation_policy.evidence: none yet; owner decision 2026-11-16 to treat as defaults pending observations
